sources.title: FY26 Q4 earnings conference call transcript
sources.excerpt: July29 2026 Nadella/Hood: Azure annual revenue surpassed100 billion up41%; 88 new datacenters this year; added1GW this quarter; GPU dock-to-live reduced nearly50%. M365 Copilot over30 million paid seats; net seat adds more than doubled quarter over quarter; M365 Commercial paid seats grew6%; Copilot/E5/E7 drove ARPU. Capital expenditures41 billion this quarter; roughly two thirds short-lived assets primarily CPUs/GPUs; total finance leases5.6 billion primarily large datacenter sites; cash paid for PP&E35.8 billion. CFO: demand continues to exceed available capacity and additional in-quarter capacity quickly monetized. Cloud gross margin65%, down year over year; Intelligent Cloud operating margin41%. RPO678 billion; excluding OpenAI increased25%; weighted average duration2.3 years; roughly30% recognized next12 months; nearly90% full-year cloud revenue from customers outside frontier-model companies. From FY27 datacenter/office building useful life extends15 to25 years; minimal FY27 operating-income benefit; more future leases classify operating rather than finance, operating leases excluded from capex; calendar2026 capex expectation approximately175 billion with investment expectations unchanged outside reclassification. FY27 capex grows, operating margins down less than1 point and free cash flow positive expected. FY27 Q1 Azure growth approximately45% constant currency; company revenue89.85 to90.95 billion; capex over50 billion. Q4 company operating margin45%; PBP58%; company headcount down2%. Management asserts model choice, substitutable models and capacity fungibility, not independently measured economics.

sources.title: April2026 amended OpenAI partnership
sources.excerpt: Apr27,2026: Microsoft remains OpenAI primary cloud partner; OpenAI products ship first on Azure unless Microsoft cannot and chooses not to support necessary capabilities. OpenAI can now serve all products across any cloud provider. Microsoft model/product IP license through2032 now non-exclusive. Microsoft no longer pays revenue share to OpenAI. OpenAI revenue-share payments to Microsoft through2030 at same percentage subject to total cap, independent of technology progress. Microsoft remains major shareholder.

revenue.note: Consolidated annual revenue, millions converted to USD.

net_income.note: Consolidated GAAP annual net income; includes OpenAI investment gains, not adjusted earnings.

operating_cash_flow.note: Consolidated annual net cash from operations. Includes SBC addback, deferred taxes and working capital; not owner earnings.

capital_expenditure.note: Positive cash additions to property/equipment, sign-normalized from reported investing outflow; same fiscal period as OCF. Excludes noncash finance lease additions and acquisitions.

eps.note: Consolidated GAAP diluted annual EPS; no split conversion, distinct from adjusted EPS17.28 and forecast19.77.

cash.note: Consolidated cash and equivalents only; excludes55.908 billion short-term investments. No claim every dollar is freely distributable.

debt.note: Explicit normalization of directly observed current9,227m plus noncurrent31,067m debt gives40,294m, excluding finance/operating leases; retained as estimate, not relabeled quoted issuer aggregate. TradingEconomics directly fetched metadata reports40.29B for quarter ending June2026, compatible rounded narrow debt but without lease definition. Vendor128,813m includes leases and cannot corroborate this exclusion basis. SEC R20 returned chronology, Last10K wrapper lacked debt-note body and issuer annual hub lacked current note; full finance-lease maturity disclosure remains unavailable.

lease_inclusive_vendor_debt.note: Secondary standardized total debt including finance and operating lease obligations; no primary all-in reconciliation claimed.

stock_based_compensation.note: GAAP expense added back in operating cash flow; economically dilutive.

cash_repurchases.note: Cash flow statement repurchases, may include settlement/tax-withholding differences versus program buybacks. Do not equate with capital-return press-release definition.

cash_dividends.note: Cash flow statement dividends paid, different from declared quarterly dividends.

q4_finance_lease_additions.note: Finance leases reported by CFO; primarily datacenter sites; not cash PP&E or full-year lease additions.41 billion headline rounded capex and35.8 billion cash PP&E/5.6 billion leases do not exactly sum; rounding/timing definitions unreconciled, not forced.

forward_eps.note: Analyst adjusted non-GAAP EPS estimate, not issuer guidance or GAAP actual. Vendor displays50 analysts for FY27; individual refresh dates unavailable. No manual conversion from historical GAAP17.95.

required_return.note: 10.5% nominal USD price-only hurdle exceeds observed5.24%10Y par yield; compensation for equity duration, execution and multiple/capital intensity risk, not a hidden fix for catastrophic risks.

risk_free_rate.note: Observed 10-year USD Treasury par yield 5.24%; percent converted to decimal. Current common reference, not a hardcoded tool default.
